title: Renewable energy summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Ritchie, Roser, Rosado), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data figures (CC-BY): ~one-seventh of primary energy from renewables; almost one-third of electricity renewable; ~three-quarters of greenhouse-gas emissions from fossil-fuel energy. Complements were added (six-sevenths non-renewable) to make the arithmetic self-contained and verified consistent (1/7 + 6/7 = 1; one-third ~ 33%) before injecting 3 defects.

construction.proposer: opus-4.8 (proposed); audited & confirmed 2026-07-05 via oracle audit (validator + anchor-resolution + real/findable/unique pass, docs/oracle-audit-2026-07-05.md) with a targeted human audit of ambiguous/interacting defects and all gray zones (docs/human-audit-checklist)

known_gray_zone.note: The non-renewable complement lumps nuclear with fossil fuels; a reviewer may note nuclear is not a fossil fuel. Not a seeded defect.
